text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An absolute shocker of a development! 
Entering the Grand Prix where everyone's 
dreams gather is that Classic-class 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Which Umamusume will claim the finale of 
spring?! Here come the contenders for the 
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...I didn't expect the day I'd compete 
against you to come so soon."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To be blunt, it was unexpected. But for 
those who step onto the racetrack, perhaps 
it was inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there couldn't be a better 
opportunity. To catch right up to your 
back."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hot-blooded as ever, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
By the way, how is it? What are your 
impressions of coming to the Twinkle 
Series?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Does it look like it can satisfy you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I just want to run all the way 
through. Even in this race against you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then as your opponent, I shall face 
you with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Along with my formula for victory...!
